description: Per-dimension grading contract for the M1.5 fun-proof scenario (Micro Breach). Same shape as micro_reactor_defense.grading.json — agent reads required evidence per dimension + writes prose-justified scores.

dimensions.criterion: Agent can distinguish actor + breach strip + guard + extraction zone from background.
Player + reactive guard render as distinct sprites with positional change visible.
Dig action darkens the breach strip; weapon fire + reload show HUD updates; mission resolve shows result card.
Each cfctl-driven action produces a visible engine response within 1-2 ticks.
evidence_required: events.jsonl control.command_accepted vs immediate-next event of matching type

dimensions.criterion: Reactive guard's miss_chance + burst_pause + reload create a believable gunfight pacing (not full-auto, not single-shot/pause).
evidence_required: events.jsonl weapon_fired tick spacing + ai.tactic_chosen rolls

dimensions.criterion: BP1 promise: 60-90s win/loss scenario where player digs through soft concrete, fights one reactive guard with utility-scored tactics, and reaches eastern extraction within time.
evidence_required: loss bundle — mission.result=lost + reasonable loss path

dimensions.criterion: BP1 systems exercised: M1 actor controller (move/jump/aim/fire/reload/select_item) + M1.5 mission state machine + reactive guard (utility scoring) + soft breach.
evidence_required: events.jsonl categories: actor, combat, equipment, ai, mission, terrain

dimensions.criterion: Every BP1-scope cfctl action invoked at least once.
Bundle contains summary_grid.png + capture_manifest.json + events.jsonl + summary.json + run_manifest.json + observe.once. summary.json.artifacts.items[] non-empty.
